preconditions.description: The length of the input string str is between 1 and 30 inclusive.
The number of allowed swaps K is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The input string str consists only of digits and is not empty.

postconditions.description: The output is a string of digits with the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: int(return_value) == max(int(''.join(p)) for p in itertools.permutations(str) if sum(c1 != c2 for c1, c2 in zip(str, p)) // 2 <= K)
postconditions.description: The output is the largest number possible by performing at most K swap operations on the digits of the input string.
